# Checks the sanitizers skip in some sources, passed to Clang with -fsanitize-ignorelist

# The tests register polymorphic classes with asOFFSET, which computes the offset by accessing the
# member through a fake pointer. The vptr check reads the type info at that pointer, which crashes.
# The check stays enabled for the library and the add-ons
[vptr]
src:*/tests/test_feature/*
